scope: 180 YAML files discovered using normal checker directory exclusions; eight data/sources YAML files excluded. Visible screen text and template content only, with English eligibility filters. No corpus files modified.
dictionary: Spylls 0.1.7 bundled en_US Hunspell dictionary plus data/spelling_words.txt

notes: There is no corpus-specific name allowlist in this pass.

Capitalized geographic choice labels are suppressed using field labels, variables and help as evidence. Metadata is not scanned. Names declared in metadata.authors and name spans in explicit attribution sections are excluded from visible prose checks.

Unfamiliar capitalized words at all sentence positions require a nearby lowercase dictionary word (single insertion, deletion or transposition) before warning. This abstains on most names and misses some capitalized typos.
The remaining false positive is Urbana in the organization heading City Life/Vida Urbana; it resembles the English word urban.
Two previously flagged brand-name typos (Izuzu and Volkswagon) are no longer reported because their intended spellings cannot be established with this English dictionary. Both were reported upstream.
Every final warning was reviewed in context. Counts are deduplicated per visible text entry, not raw token occurrences.
Rules were developed on this corpus. These are in-sample results, not independent validation. No complete spelling-error gold standard is available, so recall cannot be measured.
Known additional missed examples include Sanitory, Masachussetts and two occurrences of Admininistration due to conservative capitalized-word filters.
Valid-word errors, grammar, punctuation, code strings, attachment prose, metadata and explicit translations are outside the measured scope.
